leads.name: Skyhorse Publishing
leads.notes: New York independent publisher with over 10,000 titles across sports, outdoor, true crime, politics, and more. One of the fastest-growing independents in the country, producing hundreds of new titles per year across many imprints. Reached at the founder and publisher directly.
leads.pitch: Fast-growing NYC independent with 10,000+ titles across dozens of categories; reached at the founder/publisher.

leads.name: New Harbinger Publications
leads.source: Apollo B2B enrichment (Director of Acquisitions matched)
leads.notes: Oakland-based independent self-help and psychology publisher founded in 1973, producing 60-80 titles per year across anxiety, depression, relationships, and mindfulness. One of the most consistent short-run psychology lists in the country. Reached at their Director of Acquisitions.
leads.pitch: Leading independent psychology publisher with 60-80 new titles per year; reached at the Director of Acquisitions.

leads.name: Berrett-Koehler Publishers
leads.notes: Oakland independent publisher specializing in business, leadership, and management books since 1992. Produces 50-60 new titles per year and is one of the most respected names in the business-book space. Reached at their VP of Editorial, Jeevan Sivasubramaniam.
leads.pitch: Mission-driven business publisher with 50+ new titles per year; reached at VP Editorial.

leads.name: Greenleaf Book Group
leads.notes: Austin-based hybrid publisher and distributor founded in 1997, producing 150+ client titles per year across business, leadership, and thought leadership. One of the best-known names in hybrid publishing. Reached at CEO Tanya Hall directly.
leads.pitch: Leading hybrid publisher with 150+ client titles per year; reached at the CEO.

leads.name: Sounds True
leads.notes: Louisville, Colorado independent publisher and multimedia company founded in 1985, with 600+ titles and 3,000+ authors in mindfulness, spirituality, and self-help. One of the longest-running wellness publishers in the country. Reached at founder and publisher Tami Simon.
leads.pitch: 40-year-old independent wellness publisher with 600+ titles; reached at the founder.

leads.name: Gibbs Smith Publisher
leads.notes: Layton, Utah publisher producing full-color lifestyle, cooking, and interior design titles since 1969. Publishes 100+ titles per year in art, architecture, home, and children's. Reached at their acquisitions contact Debbie Uribe, the published submissions contact on the Gibbs Smith website.
leads.pitch: Utah lifestyle publisher with 100+ full-color titles per year; reached at the acquisitions contact.

leads.name: Schiffer Publishing
leads.notes: Atglen, Pennsylvania specialty publisher of art, antiques, collectibles, military history, and craft titles since 1974. Produces 100+ titles per year in highly specialized niche categories. Reached at publisher Pete Schiffer directly.
leads.pitch: Pennsylvania specialty publisher of 100+ art and collector titles per year; reached at the publisher.

leads.name: McFarland Publishers
leads.notes: Jefferson, North Carolina academic and reference publisher founded in 1979, producing 500+ titles per year across film, military history, sports, and reference. One of the most prolific academic publishers in the country. Reached at Executive Editor Lisa Camp.
leads.pitch: Academic publisher of 500+ reference titles per year; reached at the Executive Editor.

leads.name: University Press of Kansas

leads.pitch: Midwestern university press with 55+ scholarly titles per year; reached at the Acquisitions Editor.

leads.name: Syracuse University Press

leads.pitch: Syracuse university press with 40+ scholarly titles per year; reached at the Acquisitions Editor.

leads.name: Familius

leads.pitch: California family publisher with 40-50 titles per year; reached at the Acquisitions Editor.

leads.name: Fox Chapel Publishing
leads.notes: Mount Joy, Pennsylvania publisher of 3,500+ specialty interest books and magazines in woodworking, quilting, carving, and craft. Sells through Michaels, Hobby Lobby, Walmart, and Target. A major craft publisher with consistent high-volume output. Published submissions address from the Fox Chapel website.

leads.pitch: Distinguished Southern university press with 60+ titles per year; reached at the Acquisitions Editor.

leads.name: University of Tennessee Press

leads.pitch: Berkeley nonprofit celebrating California culture with 15-20 titles per year; reached at the GM/Editorial Director.

leads.pitch: Canadian sustainability publisher with 35+ titles per year; reached at the Acquisitions Director.
